correctness.rationale: For every n≥4, the support-graph face dimension identity implies normal cone ray-excess c(F)-1. The integral restriction map from row/column-zero matrices to missing entries has exactly the component-imbalance kernel and free quotient \(\mathbb Z^{c(F)-1}\); this proves iff smooth and all orbit local class groups. Balanced full two-block graphs exhaust inclusion-maximal disconnected faces, yielding the exact binomial count and dimensions. At each block face the transverse lattice semigroup is nonnegative pairs with equal sums, whose generators are all (e_i,e_j); its semigroup ring is the rank-one q-by-q determinantal ring, with Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity its Segre degree. Exact finite face enumeration replays n=3 and n=4 and verifies counting formulas to n=7, but does not substitute for the general proof. Hypotheses: n≥4, algebraically closed arbitrary characteristic; reduced underlying singular locus and generic transverse slices only.

value.rationale: The exact singularity classification across the natural increasing-dimensional Birkhoff toric family identifies all geometric components, their dimensions/codimensions, the entire orbitwise divisor obstruction, and precise generic transverse determinantal singularity multiplicities, rather than restating toric smoothness. The centrally binomial growth and the two distinct n=4 transverse types make the structure informative for singularity theory and toric birational studies. The count is motivated by balanced block decompositions of doubly stochastic matrices, not an arbitrary finite slice.
